name: Jeziel
title: Warrior from the tribe of Benjamin
summary: Jeziel was one of the skilled warriors from the tribe of Benjamin who joined David while he was fleeing from King Saul in Ziklag. He was known as one of those who could use both right and left hands to sling stones and shoot arrows with a bow. He is counted among David's early and loyal supporters.

keyEvents.title: Joined David in Ziklag
keyEvents.description: Jeziel was among the Benjaminite warriors who left Saul's side and joined David while he was staying in Ziklag, the Philistine city.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as son of Asmaveth
keyEvents.description: Jeziel is identified as the son of Asmaveth from Benjamin and is mentioned together with his brother Pelet among David's mighty men.

keyEvents.title: Known for ambidexterity in battle
keyEvents.description: Jeziel and the other Benjaminite warriors were known for their ability to use both right and left hands to sling stones and shoot arrows with a bow.

keyEvents.title: Part of David's growing army
keyEvents.description: Jesiel was part of the steady stream of warriors who came to David and strengthened his position as future king over Israel.
